name: Visual novel: Shadows of Ravenhall Castle
source:
Writer Elizabeth Gray never imagined she would one day become the heir to an ancient castle.

Everything changed after a letter arrived: grim Ravenhall, lost among mist-covered hills, had been left to her in the will of a man she barely knew.

It seemed simple enough: arrive, inspect the estate, sign the necessary documents, and return to her old life. But on the very first night, Elizabeth realizes that Ravenhall came to her for a reason.

Whispers echo through empty corridors. Old portraits seem to watch her every move. Candles go out without a breath of wind, and the past of the Blackwood family grows closer — and more dangerous.

The deeper Elizabeth delves into the history of the castle, the harder it becomes to understand where the investigation ends and the trap begins.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4687910]Steam[/url]]
